lead.question: 著名的圣伯纳德修道院里，那些狗有什么用途？修道士为何更喜欢冬天？
lead.warmup: 在瑞士与意大利交界处，海拔2,473米的圣伯纳德大山口是欧洲最高的山口，11世纪修建的著名修道院就坐落在离山口约一英里处。几百年来，这里驯养的圣伯纳德犬在风雪中拯救了无数翻山者的生命。每到冬天，气温降到零下30度，修道院便归于宁静。走进这座修道院，感受它四季不同的生活。
goals: 读懂圣伯纳德大山口与修道院的地理位置及彼此距离
掌握圣伯纳德犬的来历与用途，分清现在完成时与一般现在时的用法
学会 now that、despite、whenever、prefer…to… 等连接与搭配的用法
体会修道院夏冬两季截然不同的生活景象
lead.summary: 圣伯纳德大山口连接瑞士与意大利，是欧洲最高的山口，11世纪修建的修道院距它约一英里。几百年来，院里驯养的圣伯纳德犬在风雪中救过无数翻山者；它们最早从亚洲引进，罗马时代便用作看门狗。夏天游客成千上万，狗被关进围栏；冬天客人稀少，气温低至零下30度，修道士得以清静，狗也更自由。
lead.tips: prefer A to B 的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，别误写成 prefer A than B，如 prefer winter to summer（喜欢冬天胜过夏天）。

questions.q: What are the St. Bernard dogs used for?
questions.zh: 圣伯纳德犬的用途是什么？
questions.a: They are used to save the lives of travellers who attempt to cross the dangerous Pass. The dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.
questions.aZh: 它们用来拯救那些试图翻越危险山口的游客的生命。每当有游客遇险，它们就被派到雪地里去救援。
questions.hint: 见课文第4句和第6句：'St. Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers…' 及 '…the dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.'

questions.q: Where is the famous monastery of St. Bernard located, and when was it founded?
questions.zh: 著名的圣伯纳德修道院位于何处？建于何时？
questions.a: It lies about a mile away from the Pass and was founded in the eleventh century.
questions.aZh: 它位于离山口约一英里处，建于11世纪。
questions.hint: 见课文第3句：'…the famous monastery of St. Bernard, which was founded in the eleventh century, lies about a mile away.'

questions.q: Why do the monks prefer winter to summer?
questions.zh: 修道士们为什么更喜欢冬天而不喜欢夏天？
questions.a: Because in winter they have more privacy, and the dogs have greater freedom, since they are allowed to wander outside their enclosure.
questions.aZh: 因为冬天他们能有更多无人打扰的清静，而狗也更自由，可以被放出围栏到外面四处遛达。
questions.hint: 见课文：'The monks prefer winter to summer for they have more privacy.' 及 'The dogs have greater freedom, too…'。

questions.q: What happens to the dogs during the summer months, and why?
questions.zh: 夏天的时候狗会被怎样对待？原因是什么？
questions.a: They have to be kept in a special enclosure, because there are so many people about—thousands of people visit the monastery in cars.
questions.aZh: 它们不得不被关在一个专门的围栏里，因为周围游客太多——成千上万的人驱车前来参观修道院。
questions.hint: 见课文：'During the summer months, the monastery is very busy…' 与 'As there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.'

questions.q: Despite the new tunnel, why do some people still rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot?
questions.zh: 尽管有了新隧道，为什么仍有人鲁莽地徒步翻越山口？
questions.a: The tunnel makes the crossing less dangerous, but a few people still rashly attempt to cross on foot—perhaps for adventure or sport. That is exactly why the dogs are still needed today.
questions.aZh: 隧道让翻越山口不再那么危险，但仍有少数人鲁莽地徒步翻越——也许是为了冒险或运动。这也正是如今仍然需要这些狗的原因。
questions.hint: 见课文：'Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot.' 结合全文理解。

exercises.q: 汉译英：几百年来，圣伯纳德犬一直拯救着翻越这道危险山口的旅行者的生命。
exercises.a: For hundreds of years, St. Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers crossing the dangerous Pass.
exercises.note: 现在完成时表持续结果

exercises.q: 汉译英：冬天，气温降到零下30度，很少有人企图翻越山口。
exercises.a: In winter, the temperature drops to minus 30 degrees and very few people attempt to cross the Pass.

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 Now that 改写 'As there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.'
exercises.a: Now that there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.

exercises.q: 填空：The monks prefer winter ______ summer because they have more privacy.
exercises.note: prefer A to B 固定搭配

exercises.q: 改错：Despite of the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rushly attempt to cross the Pass.
exercises.a: Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the Pass.
exercises.note: 去掉 of；正确词是 rashly

exercises.q: 填空：The dogs are kept in a special ______ so that they cannot wander about among the crowds.
汉译英：这些热爱高山清静的年轻人每年都受到修道院的热情欢迎。
exercises.a: These young people, who love the peace of the mountains, always receive a warm welcome at the monastery every year.

quiz.q: 根据课文，圣伯纳德犬最出名的是哪一点？
options: Saving the lives of travellers lost in the snow
Being a great summer tourist attraction
Pulling sledges for the monks in winter
Frightening away the skiers at the monastery

quiz.q: 填空：'For hundreds of years, St. Bernard dogs ______ the lives of travellers.' 空白处应填：
options: have saved
saved
are saving
save

quiz.q: 'Now that a tunnel has been built, the Pass is less dangerous.' 中 now that 的含义是：
options: Because / Since
Although
As soon as
In case

quiz.q: The monks prefer winter to summer 的意思是：
options: They like winter better than summer
They dislike both winter and summer
They like summer better than winter
They treat winter and summer equally
quiz.note: prefer A to B 喜A胜B

quiz.q: 与 'Despite the new tunnel, a few people still attempt to cross the Pass on foot.' 意思最接近的是：
options: Although a tunnel has been built, a few people still cross on foot
Because a tunnel has been built, nobody crosses on foot
The tunnel has stopped all people from crossing on foot
Since the tunnel is new, everyone crosses the Pass by car

quiz.q: 哪个词最能形容修道士们冬天安静的生活？
options: Solitary
Crowded
Noisy
Dangerous
